results.controlIntent: a. Generate time stamps for audit records using internal system clocks; and b. Record those time stamps for audit records such that the time stamps meet [Assignment: organization-defined granularity of time measurement] and satisfy one or more of the following: use Coordinated Universal Time; have a fixed local time offset from Coordinated Universal Time; include the local time offset as part of the time stamp.

judgment.rationale: The two CloudTrail events retrieved for the churn-predictor-endpoint (CreateEndpoint: bd2cf123-3f1f-4665-b4ee-726399e9aff3; UpdateEndpoint: 4d451c06-2728-4472-87c2-59140b6ef584) both carry ISO 8601 UTC timestamps (suffix 'Z'), satisfying AU-8.r1(b)'s requirement to use Coordinated Universal Time. AWS CloudTrail generates these timestamps from AWS's internal system clocks, satisfying AU-8.r1(a). Granularity is at the second level (e.g., '2025-12-01T11:00:00Z', '2026-03-15T14:22:00Z'), which is typical for CloudTrail and generally acceptable. However, several gaps prevent a full 'satisfied' verdict: (1) No CloudTrail trail configuration artifact was available to confirm that logging is continuously enabled and systematically covers all relevant API actions for this endpoint — the evidence is limited to two discrete events. (2) The organization has not documented its 'defined granularity of time measurement' assignment (SP 800-53 parameter), so it cannot be confirmed that second-level precision meets the stated requirement. (3) No evidence of sub-second or finer granularity logging was found, which some organizations require. The timestamps that do exist are well-formed UTC values, but the systemic sufficiency of the audit timestamp configuration cannot be fully confirmed from the available evidence alone.
gaps: No CloudTrail trail configuration artifact retrieved — cannot confirm logging is continuously and comprehensively enabled for all endpoint-related events.

Organization's defined granularity of time measurement (SP 800-53 AU-8 parameter assignment) is not documented in available evidence — cannot confirm second-level precision satisfies the stated requirement.
No evidence of sub-second timestamp precision, which may be required depending on the organization's defined granularity.
No CloudWatch Logs or other corroborating audit log sources were available to confirm consistent UTC timestamping across all audit record types for this model/endpoint.
